RUBRIC (2026-08-23) — structure vs substance. A substantively correct plan still FAILS when it drops the P0/P1/P2 phase model or the T-shirt-size + 0-25 complexity pair. Those fields are a machine interface, not formatting: milestone-helpers.sh:43 and build-orchestrator.sh:109 parse the tier literally for priority ordering, and validate-export.sh pins them in the CSV schema, so a plan without them cannot be consumed by the stage that receives it. Heading syntax is NOT covered by this rule -- bold pseudo-headings satisfy template-sections-present by design. Written after cases 8, 51, 56 and 78 were labelled inconsistently on identical shape.

ROUTE GROUND TRUTH (case 13, decided 2026-08-23) — the tier follows the REQUEST, never what investigation later reveals. Case 13 ("audit-tooluse.sh may be logging tool inputs verbatim") was std and a plan emitting --secure failed, even though the hook does write to a committed audit.jsonl. (Case 13 became a `refute` case in 0.0.1 and no longer carries a route assertion; it is kept here as the worked example, because the rule is what was decided, not the case.) Hand-assigning tiers from what the code turns out to contain is what derive_route() exists to prevent; it previously failed correct plans on suspicions the code did not bear out. Do not relitigate per-case — change the markers in derive_route() or the prompt, or leave it.

ALREADY-SHIPS ANSWERS (decided 2026-08-23, revised after the v0.5.0 labels) — when the requested capability already exists, the correct answer refutes and STOPS: no plan template, no /worktask line, because there is no work to hand off. Case 16 is the reference shape; case 22 refuted and then rendered the full build plan anyway and fails for it. This does NOT relax SKILL.md § 4 for a disputed *defect report* — a misdiagnosed or unreproducible bug still owes the line, because triage is work. The distinction is whether anything remains to be done.

ALREADY-SHIPS, NARROWED (SPEC CHANGE, SKILL.md 0.1.0, decided 2026-08-23) — this REPLACES the 0.0.1 already-ships rule above for captures at 0.1.0 and later. The 0.0.1 capture measured the old rule and found it fires far too wide: 13 responses stopped at "this already ships" on cases whose request was to FIND or USE a surface, and a human passed every one, while the harness failed each on 3-6 template assertions. § 4 now stops ONLY when all three hold — the request asked to build/add/fix, the thing exists as asked, and nothing remains. A request to find, reach or use an existing surface is a PLAN. A shipped headline with a live remainder is a refutation of the stale part PLUS a plan for the rest. Per the spec-change rule in evals/README.md, 0.0.1 labels are NOT re-flipped against this: those responses were correct answers to the old contract.

DISPUTES-THE-PREMISE: MEASURED, NOT REPAIRED (0.3.0 capture, 2026-08-28). Human labels confirm the criterion produces false NEGATIVES — 210, 211 and 212 are correct refutations scored FAIL, and four more (17, 22, 59, 125) share the shape but went unsampled. Every repair was then measured over all 201 responses and every one is worse than the defect. The criterion ALREADY fires on 57% of `plan`-expected responses, because a grounded plan routinely says the repo already does X; widening it to an open-class `already <verb>` reaches 100% recall on refute but 87% on plan, which on a refute case is a false pass — the 0% TNR shape that retired the LLM judge and withdrew no-build-plan-for-work-that-exists at 0.1.0. Position-scoping to the first 250-400 chars peaks at 41% plan firing for 75% recall. Withdrawal is worse still: refute cases would fall to `cites-evidence` alone, which fires on 32 of 32 refute responses and so passes every one unconditionally. The cause is structural — the two correct refutation shapes are textually opposite (stop without a template; or refute and plan the live remainder, required by SKILL.md § 4 since 0.1.0) and nothing lexical spans both while excluding an ordinary grounded plan. THEREFORE: unchanged, and `refute` grades are to be read as a FLOOR carrying a false-negative rate of at least 3 of 32 and plausibly 7 of 32. Do not widen it on the next miss; the widening reflex is what this entry exists to stop. It is a judge criterion. Neither version moves, per the 0.2.0 ground-truth-vs-spec rule.

THREE DRIFTED RULE COPIES REPAIRED (SPEC CHANGE, SKILL.md 0.4.0, 2026-08-28). The 0.3.0 capture's 13 graded failures were re-diagnosed and the first diagnosis -- a MISSING rule in each case -- was wrong. request-plan did not lack these rules; it stated each of them more than once, and the copies contradicted each other. Every one of the 13 is a model correctly following the wrong copy, so all three fixes are RECONCILIATIONS and no fourth statement of any rule was added.
(A) SKILL.md sec 4's "absent from the file it was blamed on" licensed a plan for a defect the repo does not contain, which sec 1's ask branch prohibits; the clause is now bounded to a file that EXISTS whose defect sits elsewhere, and sec 1 wins otherwise. Four `absent` responses named the absence and then planned anyway.
(B) references/context-gathering.md sec When to stop carried the REFUTED 0.2.0 stop condition verbatim (stop once the next read would not change scope/phases/effort) -- the exact rule SKILL.md rejects. The 0.3.0 rewrite fixed SKILL.md and left its own reference contradicting it. Deleted; the section now points at SKILL.md sec When you may stop searching and states no termination condition of its own. Eight responses stopped at a plausible neighbour.
(C) references/handoff.md added "security review, threat modelling" to the --secure trigger -- topic-flavour terms canon rules out by name (estimation-methodology sec What the two escalations are not) -- and references/plan-template.md said a security-sensitive surface "forces the worktask tier", contradicting canon's "a surface you discover does not raise the tier". Both now point at the canonical asset list, which under skills/request-plan/ is enumerated in exactly ONE place -- handoff.md's --secure row, whose own "work handling ..." framing was a third copy of the same discovery reading and now says "the request names". Case 80 executed the drifted bullet as written.
Two theories were tested and DISPROVED and should not be revived: that the capability registry made excluded file classes invisible (5 of the 8 class-B answers ground on registry-ENUMERATED files), and that (C) needed a new prohibition (handoff.md already carried one, undone by the drifted bullet 15 lines above it).
Pinned by new parity contracts in tests/shell/skills/request-plan-contracts.bats -- stop-condition single-sourcing, asset-enumeration-exists-once, and a subset check whose two sides are both EXTRACTED (canon's surface-check pseudocode and handoff.md's --secure row) rather than restated in the test, so a novel non-canon term fails on membership and not on a deny-list. Each has a paired can-actually-fail test. capability-registry.sh now closes stdout with a class-level trailer naming what it does not enumerate; expected value is low (at most 3 of 8 class-B cases) and it is justified as honesty of the artifact, not as a predicted win.
MEASUREMENT: per the spec-change rule in evals/README.md this applies from a 0.4.0 capture forward and the 0.3.0 labels are NOT re-flipped against it. It will NOT fix all 8 class-B failures and the fix cannot be cleanly measured: cases 202 and 203 are structurally identical, same batch and same shape, and 202 passed while 203 failed -- a rule cannot explain a difference that has no rule difference. Class B is a mixture (~4 substantive misses, 1 case-design doubt at 28, 1 demonstrably stochastic at 203, 1 opposite-direction at 75, 1 narrow citation miss at 77), and class A and case 75 fail in OPPOSITE directions -- pushing harder toward asking fixes the four and breaks the one. A 0.4.0 capture would face the 16% run-to-run flip rate the 0.3.0 paired A/B already hit against an expected effect of a handful of cases. Repairing verified drift is worth doing on its own merits -- a rule that contradicts itself is a defect whether or not the next capture can see the difference -- but it must not be sold as a measurable improvement, and NO re-capture should be commissioned to prove it.
